requirements.title: IS_CONTIGUOUS admits ARRAY of any type
requirements.definition: The language admits IS_CONTIGUOUS ARRAY arguments of any type; this is a permission/admission, not a processor result requirement by itself.

pending.IS_CONTIGUOUS-ARRAY-any-type-admitted: Positive source/effect plan calls IS_CONTIGUOUS for integer, real, complex, logical, character, and derived-type target arrays. For each type, first verify distinguished whole-array contents and assert the whole array is contiguous true, then associate a pointer with a noncontiguous section of that same type and assert false; mutating the section stride to one makes the paired false observation fail load-bearingly.

requirements.title: IS_CONTIGUOUS argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be assumed-rank or an array, and pointer ARRAY arguments shall be associated.

pending.IS_CONTIGUOUS-ARRAY-assumed-rank-or-arra: Positive control calls IS_CONTIGUOUS in an assumed-rank wrapper with scalar and rank-one actuals plus a direct rank-one array; source-control mutation attempts a scalar non-assumed-rank call and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.IS_CONTIGUOUS-pointer-ARRAY-associated: Positive control associates a pointer with a contiguous target before calling IS_CONTIGUOUS; source-control mutation leaves the pointer disassociated and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: IS_CONTIGUOUS result is default logical scalar
requirements.definition: The IS_CONTIGUOUS result is a default logical scalar.

requirements.title: IS_CONTIGUOUS result truth value
requirements.definition: IS_CONTIGUOUS returns true for rank-zero ARRAY or a contiguous ARRAY, and false for a noncontiguous ARRAY.

pending.IS_CONTIGUOUS-rank-zero-true: Call an assumed-rank wrapper with a scalar actual initialized to a distinguished value and assert IS_CONTIGUOUS(dummy) is true; companion noncontiguous pointer case prevents vacuous all-true behavior.
pending.IS_CONTIGUOUS-contiguous-array-true: Call IS_CONTIGUOUS on a whole rank-one target and on a contiguous pointer associated with the whole target; assert true after first verifying the target values are distinguished.
pending.IS_CONTIGUOUS-noncontiguous-array-false: Associate a pointer with TARGET(1:10:2), verify the pointer sees the distinguished odd-index values, and assert IS_CONTIGUOUS(pointer) is false; mutate the section stride to one.

accounting.rationale: Description defines the intrinsic purpose and cross-references CONTIGUOUS concepts.
Classifies IS_CONTIGUOUS as an inquiry function.
Arguments paragraph is split into the any-type admission and the remaining program restrictions.
Admits ARRAY arguments of any type; it is not a requirement that any particular type-specific result differ.
Unnumbered program restrictions on ARRAY form and pointer association.
Exact logical result value for rank-zero, contiguous, and noncontiguous cases.
Example paragraph is illustrative; the false strided-pointer case is already covered by Result Value text.
